# Supplementary Figure 3 — RfaH

Fold-switching of the RfaH C-terminal domain: **5OND** (α-hairpin) vs **2LCL** (β-barrel),
scored by Cα-RMSD to each reference (x = `2lcl_rmsd`, y = `5ond_rmsd`).

**Method (divide-and-conquer → occurrence voting).** Clade-based divide-and-conquer spreads
the MSA across the two folds; occurrence voting enriches each state; the top-16 sequences
per state are re-predicted (5 models × 8 seeds = 40 structures), against a random control.

**Figure** = `four_panel_2lcl_5ond_rmsd.png`, generated by
`results_updated/RfaH/run1/replot_four_panel_rmsd.py`. Sources copied (read-only) from
`results_updated/RfaH/run1/`.

| Panel | Backing CSV (this folder) | Source | Rows |
|-------|---------------------------|--------|------|
| Divide & Conquer | `panel1_divide_and_conquer_structure_analysis.csv` | `divide_and_conquer/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 3,050 |
| α-hairpin (5OND) top-16 | `panel2_5ond_alpha_hairpin_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_5ond/results/top_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |
| β-barrel (2LCL) top-16 | `panel3_2lcl_beta_barrel_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_2lcl/results/top_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |
| Random control | `panel4_random_control.csv` | `occurrence_voting_2lcl/results/random_pred/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |

References: `5OND_processed_chainA.pdb` (α-hairpin; NTD 1–97 + CTD 118–155), `2LCL_processed_chainA.pdb` (β-barrel; CTD 118–155); config `config_5ond_2lcl_rmsd_revised.json`.
